_comment: Phase 4 (P4-3) model prices, read from Anthropic's pricing page on checkedAt, never from memory. Integer micro-USD per million tokens ($2.00/MTok = 2000000), so a cost is tokens * price / 10^6 with no float. assist:run refuses when checkedAt is older than 60 days. Haiku 5.5's figures hold for prompts up to promptTokensUpTo; above that its price is $0.50 / $2.50 per MTok.
